# Switzertemplates

> Premium digital products for female small business owners, coaches, consultants, therapists, and service providers. Top 1% Etsy seller. Star Seller. 27,700+ sales. 2,800+ reviews.

Switzertemplates is a Sydney-based digital product business founded and run by Jane Switzer, with 10+ years of experience in design and digital products. Products are used by coaches, consultants, therapists, beauty specialists, wellness professionals, and service-based businesses worldwide.

## Products

- [3-in-1 Business Bundles – $82 USD](https://switzertemplates.com): Premade Wix website + Canva landing page + full branding kit in one cohesive style. Solves branding, web presence, and lead capture in a single purchase. The flagship offer.
- [Premade Wix Websites – $64 USD](https://switzertemplates.com): Modern, minimalist, sales-ready websites for coaches, consultants, and service-based businesses. Easy to customise and publish fast.
- [Full Branding Kits – $38 USD](https://switzertemplates.com): 1,000+ Canva templates covering social media, ebooks, email marketing, business cards, flyers, signs, gift cards, and related collateral.
- [Instagram Template Packs – $15 USD](https://switzertemplates.com): Posts and carousels in modern editorial style for business owners, coaches, and consultants.
